thinkingMessage.text:
Checking MCP route registration and web/src/connect to locate the public API surface.

Now examining TypeScript files for client-side API paths.

A GraphQL schema was not found in the repository.

The actual public API is Protobuf/gRPC with REST gateway, Connect RPC for browsers, and OpenAPI spec. Schema source is `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (8 service files plus `common.proto`). Generated OpenAPI lives at `proto/gen/openapi.yaml`. Additional surfaces include SSE, file server, RSS, and MCP.

Code generation is configured in `proto/buf.gen.yaml` for Go and TypeScript. The main server runs on Echo in `server/server.go`. API v1 routes live in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (lines 64–146): gRPC-Gateway at `/api/v1/*` and `/file/*`, Connect at `/memos.api.v1.*`, SSE at `/api/v1/sse`, file server at `/attachments/:uid/:filename` and `/users/:identifier/avatar`, RSS at `/explore/rss.xml` and `/u/:username/rss.xml`, MCP at `/mcp`, and health at `/healthz`. Business logic is implemented in `server/router/api/v1/*_service.go`.

The web client at `web/src/connect.ts` consumes Connect RPC via proto-generated TypeScript types.
